answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral, and evidence of coordinated equivocation links aliases to one controller. When k identities cast conflicting votes, the penalty scales as O(k^2), making each added sybil increasingly costly. Upon detection, the swarm also receives an exponential multiplier on capital loss through escrow forfeiture and asymmetric depreciation. Thus a shale, sparrow, or lantern label cannot conceal correlated behavior or preserve its stake.
